public_rationale: The records establish substantial exposure to OpenAI, but they do not establish the claimed combined dollar balance and percentage. Microsoft's earlier 45% disclosure cannot be extended to other suppliers or to Anthropic. Contract announcements, hardware contributions and investments cannot simply be added as RPO. The aggregate's accounting basis is also unspecified.
limitations: The suppliers report different scopes and fiscal dates.
The claim's unspecified accounting basis prevents a supported or contradicted money assessment.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI and Anthropic account for at least 50% (about $748B) of hyperscaler remaining performance obligations.

statement.excerpt: Now OpenAI and Anthropic represent 50% or more of hyperscaler remaining performance obligations, or around $748 billion.

our_interpretation: Read this as two linked assertions: the labs account for at least half of hyperscaler RPO, and their attributable balance is approximately $748 billion.
Use Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon and Oracle as the working hyperscaler set, following the supplied context and screening criteria. The speaker does not explicitly define the set.

Use the latest reported fiscal-quarter-end snapshots before the post: March 2026 for calendar-quarter reporters and May 2026 for Oracle. The target interval accommodates those reporting dates; it is not a period over which RPO is summed.
The passage does not identify the accounting basis or provenance of the aggregate. Do not assume announced contract values equal recognized remaining performance obligations.
No numerical tolerance for 'around' is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: A reconciled, consistently scoped schedule shows approximately $748 billion of remaining obligations attributable to the two labs and a share of at least 50% of the same hyperscalers' total RPO.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A comparable customer-level reconciliation establishes a share below 50% or an attributable balance materially inconsistent with approximately $748 billion.
